seo.title: Your Company — business law firm in Tashkent
seo.description: Corporate law, tax disputes, M&A, data protection and support for foreign investors in Uzbekistan. A fixed price per stage and a reply within a day.
seo.answer: Your Company is a law firm in Tashkent, founded in 2012, handling company matters in Uzbekistan: corporate law, tax, litigation, M&A deals, IT and personal data, and support for foreign investors. Registering a company with foreign participation starts from 12,000,000 UZS in 10 working days; an initial one-hour consultation starts from 1,500,000 UZS.

listing.description: A website for a law firm, consultancy or financial company. A Swiss grid with rulers and numbered paragraphs, practices as a register, partners and anonymised cases.

sections.title: Law you can
sections.subtitle: We support companies and investors in Uzbekistan, from registration and contracts to tax audits, courts and deals. Every stage has a fixed price and a clear timeline.

sections.label: The firm
sections.title: We speak the language of business and of law at the same time
sections.text: Twenty-two lawyers and four partners. A partner personally leads every matter, from the first meeting to the result. We don’t promise the outcome of a lawsuit, but we always set out the risks, chances and cost before you decide. We work in Russian, Uzbek and English.

items.a: An initial consultation with a partner lasts an hour and costs from 1,500,000 UZS. If you sign an engagement agreement, the amount is credited towards the work.

items.q: How long does it take to register a company with foreign participation?
items.a: Usually 10 working days from receipt of the documents, including opening a bank account. The cost is from 12,000,000 UZS.

items.q: Do you work on an hourly basis?
items.a: Yes, but we usually offer a fixed price per stage so the budget is clear in advance. A partner’s hourly rate starts from 2,000,000 UZS.

items.q: Can you guarantee the outcome in court?
items.a: No, and nobody honestly can. We give a written assessment of the chances and risks before a dispute begins and act to reduce those risks.
Yes. Confidentiality is set out in the agreement, our staff sign non-disclosure undertakings, and documents are kept in a secure system.

items.q: Do you work with clients from abroad?
items.a: Yes, about half of our clients are foreign companies. We meet online and prepare documents in Russian, Uzbek and English.
